description: Answers "how did we get double booked?": for one night and one room type, every stay that held it (cancelled ones included) in the order it took the night, with how many rooms of that type were left at that moment, through what and by whom; the booking site's oversold alerts (owners and admins) and any booked-past-full overrides. Group holds are not rooms sold. Needs the owner's sign-in.
name: night_sales
title: How one night sold
